title: Contrast-enhanced ultrasound in diagnostic and interventional radiological imaging: Technical outcomes, clinical results, and complications
summary: This study examines how effective contrast-enhanced ultrasound is for patients and whether it is safe. It assesses the success rate and potential side effects. The data is collected and analyzed from the image files and patient records.

interventions.name: Retrospective collection of all patient data for patients who underwent contrast-enhanced ultrasound at Großhadern Hospital between 2005 and 2020. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients who underwent one or more contrast-enhanced ultrasound examinations at the Department of Radiology, Grosshadern/Innenstadt Hospital, between 2005 and 2020.
A total of 8,500 to 15,000 patients are expected to be included in the study.
Exclusion criteria:
Missing information regarding the clinical course.
Missing image data sets in the PACS.
